"The UK 10-year gilt yield climbed back above 5.2% on Tuesday, recovering from near two-month lows as investors awaited Thursday's Bank of England policy decision and the US midterm elections."
Page also notes: borrowing costs eased in October following Chancellor John Healey's budget, which adhered to fiscal rules and reassured markets. The BoE is expected to deliver its first rate hike since 2023 on Thursday amid inflationary pressures, though policymakers are anticipated to resist market expectations of additional increases in 2027.
